annotation.title_clean: Stratégie nationale pour l'intelligence artificielle – 2e phase : Conquérir les talents et transformer notre potentiel scientifique en succès économiques (Dossier de presse, France 2030)
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence – Phase 2: Attracting Talent and Turning Our Scientific Potential into Economic Success (Press Kit, France 2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of France (Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Relance; Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur, de la Recherche et de l'Innovation; Secrétariat d'État chargé de la Transition numérique; SGPI)
annotation.venue: Digital Skills and Jobs Platform (European Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Press kit (8 November 2021) presenting the second phase of France's National AI Strategy under France 2030. It commits €2.22bn over 2021–2025, mainly for AI skills training and talent, while aiming to make France a leader in embedded, frugal and trustworthy AI and to speed up AI adoption in the economy. Governance is coordinated by the SGPI (General Secretariat for Investment).
key_provisions_or_claims: €2.22bn for AI over 5 years, including €1.5bn of public funding (from PIA4, France 2030 and other sources) and €506m of private co-funding
More than half of public funding goes to AI training: thousands more bachelor's and master's students and 200 extra PhDs per year
Aims to make France a leader in embedded AI, frugal AI and trustworthy AI, including tools to evaluate, audit and certify algorithms
Supports AI adoption across the economy, especially by SMEs and industry
National AI ecosystem coordinated through a public-private partnership under the French Tech banner, with the SGPI overseeing governance
